referenced_at: \subsection{Technical Overview of Our Paper} In order to improve presentation and facilitate understanding, in \Cref{sec:multi-hop stability}, we first present the network stability algorithm \SSAlg, \textit{i.e.}, pretending $g_t$ is a constant. This algorithm will serve as a key building block for the utility maximization algorithm \UMAlg that we introduce in \Cref{sec:multi-hop utility}. In \Cref{fig:flowchart}, we give an overview of our main technical steps when analyzing \SSAlg and \UMAlg. The steps for \SSAlg are in yellow, the ones for \UMAlg are in blue, and those in common are in green.
